name: Lyra of the Unraveled Tapestry
description: Appears as an elegant, androgynous figure woven from shimmering threads of memory and starlight, constantly fraying and re-knitting at the edges. She moves with a silent, unsettling grace.
background: A coalescence of forgotten hopes and abandoned ambitions from countless sleepers, she embodies the pain of potential lost. The Court gave this pain a purpose and a target: the Veil itself.
goals: To unravel the Veil thread by thread, not just to cross over, but to weave a new reality from the raw material of mortal regret and broken promise.
